seo_observations.recommendation: Use a distinct, descriptive title with the primary topic; length is a display heuristic, not a ranking rule
Write a clear summary and value proposition; search engines may rewrite snippets
Use a clear page topic and a meaningful heading hierarchy

seo_observations.recommendation: Review informative images for descriptive alt text; decorative images may correctly use empty alt
Review canonical URL choices if duplicate URL versions exist

warnings: OFFLINE TEST: all upstream HTTP responses simulated; not a live analysis
